attchmntText: Hitech Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Hitech Corporation Limited approved audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the resignation of Mr. Prashant Adhatrao as Data Protection Officer, effective November 30, 2026. Mr. Siddhesh Natekar was appointed as Data Protection Officer and Senior Management Personnel, effective December 01, 2026. The Board Meeting was held on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Hitech Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
